create.title: Create a course
create.intro: Answer a few questions, copy the prompt into a chat AI, then import its reply. Step by step, even a big course never gets cut off.
create.mode.label: What do you want to do?
create.preset.label: Start from
create.preset.examDesc: Built around your handouts and notes, with exam-style questions.
create.preset.programmingDesc: Code examples, reading and predicting code, typical bugs.
create.preset.understandDesc: Clear explanations with comparisons and worked examples.
create.preset.refresherDesc: Two short units in one reply, ideal before a test.
create.preset.deep-diveDesc: Many units, thorough lessons and a final exam.
create.preset.customDesc: Keep your current settings and adjust everything yourself.
create.subject: Subject
create.subjectHelp: Courses are grouped by subject in Explore and Progress.
create.priorHint: Binary numbers, what an IP address is
create.source.attached: I attach files in the chat (PDF, photos)
create.material: Your notes, handout text or slides
create.materialLong: That is a lot of text. Some chat tools cut long messages, so attaching the file can work better.
create.attachedHelp: Attach your files to the first message (the outline). Units are written in the same chat, so the AI can still see them.
create.strict.mainly: My material first, fill gaps with general knowledge (marked as extra)
create.cite: Show where each answer comes from (handout, page)
create.lang.bilingual: German and English, with a switch in each lesson
create.bilingualNote: Two languages make every reply about twice as long. Step-by-step mode keeps that manageable.
create.terms.primary: Keep exam terms in the main language
create.terms.both: Show the other language the first time
create.autoSize: Let the AI choose the size
create.gen.stepwise: Step by step: outline first, then one unit per reply (recommended)
create.gen.single: Everything in one reply (only for small courses)
create.operators: German exam task verbs (Operatoren, AFB I-III)
create.extra.videos: YouTube videos (in English, ready to play)
create.extra: Anything else the AI should know
create.extraHint: Use examples from a school network.
create.tip.chatgpt: ChatGPT: use a thinking model if you have one. It follows long instructions more reliably.
create.tip.claude: Claude: if the reply opens as a document on the side, copy it from there.
create.tip.gemini: Gemini: use the Pro model for long courses.
create.tip.deepseek: DeepSeek: turn on DeepThink for better questions.
create.tip.newChat: Start a new chat for each new course, then keep using that chat for its units.
create.tip.cutOff: If a reply stops in the middle, send: "Your reply was cut off. Write the same unit again, a bit shorter."
create.prompt.single: The whole course in one reply
create.how.2: Paste it into {tool} in a new chat.
create.how.2attached: Paste it into {tool} in a new chat and attach your files.
create.how.3: Copy the JSON it replies with.
create.how.5: Then open "Continue a course" here for the prompt of each unit.
create.needTopic: Enter a topic in step 1 first.
create.continue.none: Import an outline first. Its units show up here.
create.continue.help: Send these in the same chat as the outline, one at a time, and import each reply before the next.
create.savedSettings: Using the settings this course was created with.
create.currentSettings: This course was not planned here, so your current settings are used.
create.fix.hint: On the Import page, use "Copy errors", paste them here together with the reply, and send the fix prompt in the same chat.
